title: When the Typewriter Breaks
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Odile Ravensworth, a typeface cutter's daughter in a print shop on the eve of a revolution, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
